local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local elapsed=0;local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or done then return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<2 then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during ingestion boot')
 assert(self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1d0c8),'Ingestion source is not upper Blood Feast')
 local ally=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x98138))
 assert(ally and ally:isValid() and not types.Actor.isDead(ally),'Ilend is not alive at ingestion boot')
 local enemy=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x93ee1))
 assert(enemy and enemy:isValid() and types.Actor.isDead(enemy),'Earned second Dremora death was not restored')
 done=true;print('ShaderLoader earned source ready')
end}}}}
